responsibility: Contains the primary RTL machine description for the S/390 backend: instruction patterns, expanders, unspec/unspecv enumerations, operand formatting conventions, condition-code behavior, split-stack patterns, HTM operations, string and rawmem helpers, and many core scalar code-generation rules. This is the main pattern file that maps GCC RTL operations onto System z instructions and cooperates with constraints.md, predicates.md, vector.md, and the scheduler files.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-name s390 files, this is the machine-description pattern file, containing define_insn/define_expand rules and UNSPEC enums that map RTL to System z instructions. Unlike s390.cc it is not C++ hook code, unlike s390.h it is not a macro/struct header, and unlike s390.opt it is not an option table.
